title: Convergence towards Ideal Poisson--Voronoi tessellations with a focus on Diestel--Leader graphs
summary: We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for convergence towards a unique IPVT on any proper pointed measured metric space. The conditions are that the volume function, when composed with $\log$, is regularly varying and that the limit of the uniform probability measure on a large ball exists in the horocompactification. As an application we prove convergence towards a unique IPVT for higher rank symmetric spaces, which solves an open problem of \cite{MiMe23}.
